negative_reviews.author: Anon ymous
negative_reviews.text: After visiting the Leeds branch I was excited to try M&R again. Unfortunately I felt sheffield was very disappointing. The kitchen was tiny and food was very clearly mass produced and rushed out. This was reflected in the flavour which was really bland. Won't be coming back and do not recommend you visit this branch.

negative_reviews.author: Vivian White
negative_reviews.text: A very disappointed dining experience.we stand at the entrance waited at least 20mins and no one greeted us ,no one paid attention to us . The person standing behind us left before we could wait . Finally we sat down planning to order but had to wait for another 20 mins. We found that there were only 2 people working on the floor so we planned to be considerate of them . We order ramen katsu curry rice and some side , my partner ramen served quick , but I didn’t expect katsu curry rice and side need to wait around 25 min and taste terrible ,we were really disappointed with that , to be honest the restaurant not full but we saw few table got same issues some of them already eating sushi and ramen but other one have to wait their food .at the end we need to wait more than 15 mins for the bill …
